query: INSERT INTO central.artifact_reconciliation_claims (artifact_id, workspace_id, claim_kind, coordinator_generation, claim_token_hash, lease_expires_at, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 1, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (artifact_id) DO UPDATE SET claim_kind = EXCLUDED.claim_kind, coordinator_generation = EXCLUDED.coordinator_generation, claim_token_hash = EXCLUDED.claim_token_hash, lease_expires_at = EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at, attempt_count = central.artifact_reconciliation_claims.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp()
